top_categories.workout_context: Road-specific control matters at 3RIDES Gran Fondo Südliche Weinstrasse. Practice on rolling hills: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 62 miles.
Race-pace efforts that mimic 3RIDES Gran Fondo Südliche Weinstrasse's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before April.
When someone attacks on rolling hills, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
3RIDES Gran Fondo Südliche Weinstrasse's rolling hills rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.

Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at 3RIDES Gran Fondo Südliche Weinstrasse. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.
At 3RIDES Gran Fondo Südliche Weinstrasse, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of 3RIDES Gran Fondo Südliche Weinstrasse. Train it until it feels boring.
2-minute all-out efforts on rolling hills. Closing gaps, responding to attacks, sprinting for position. Train the burn.
62 miles on rolling hills burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
Smooth pedaling at 62 miles saves muscle. Bad technique at mile 10 is invisible. At mile 80 it's a cramp.
Varied gradients on rolling hills demand climbing versatility. Sit the shallow stuff, stand the steep stuff, switch without thinking.
Long rides with hard efforts mixed in. Simulates what 3RIDES Gran Fondo Südliche Weinstrasse's rolling hills actually does to you.

race_overlay.nutrition: Use training to rehearse an eating and drinking plan for 3RIDES Gran Fondo Südliche Weinstrasse's 62 miles. Start early and use products you tolerate. The organizer has not published a reliable resupply plan, so rehearse a self-sufficient carry and revise it when the rider document is released.
race_overlay.altitude: Altitude may change sustainable power and recovery at 3RIDES Gran Fondo Südliche Weinstrasse. Use conservative pacing and test any travel strategy before the event.
race_overlay.terrain: The technical descents at 3RIDES Gran Fondo Südliche Weinstrasse demand practice on similar paved roads. Ride rolling hills at race-day cadence weekly. Practice braking points, corner entry, line choice, and accelerating smoothly out of turns. Confirm tire pressure and equipment before race week.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Road Specific, Race Simulation, and VO2max to prepare you for 62 miles of rolling hills in Porte des Vins Allemands (German Wine Gate), Schweigen-Rechtenbach, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany.
